name: lemonade
description: Local Lemonade models only (Cline + provider lemonade, no cloud anywhere, $0 per run): Qwen3.8-27B (Qwen) builds, Muse-Glimmer-30B (Meta, another family) reviews and plans, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B (Qwen) is the fallback dev model. Qwen3.8 passed kanban models vet for dev and QA (2026-10-13), Muse-Glimmer for dev and QA (2026-10-12), Qwen3-Coder for dev and QA (2026-10-13); none was vetted for plan. Needs Lemonade's max_loaded_models at 3 and the Cline turn detector on

dev.note: Cline on the dev tier's pick (Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF-UD-Q4_K_XL, passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-13)

qa.note: Muse-Glimmer-30B (passed kanban models vet for dev and QA 2026-10-12): another family (meta) than the Qwen3.8 dev model and the Qwen3-Coder fallback model (both qwen), with vision, so it reads screenshots. It replaces gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF-Q4_K_M, which passed the QA vet (2026-10-13-qa-cline-khuf9) but proved too small for a reliable QA reviewer in the notes project (2026-10-13)

plan.note: plans run on Muse-Glimmer-30B (the QA model, not vetted for plan; passed dev and QA 2026-10-12) in Cline's plan mode (--plan), so a plan card loads no model beyond the three resident ones

fallback.note: fallback dev model (Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct-GGUF-Q4_K_M, passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-13) on the dev role's agent; the fallback only, not a dev pick: as a dev model in the notes project it emitted invalid JSON tool calls on Lemonade (2026-10-13)

candidates.note: in use (not vetted for plan; passed dev and QA 2026-10-12): the QA model, so a plan card loads no extra model; 65536 context as Lemonade loads it
candidate (not vetted for plan; passed dev and QA 2026-10-13): the dev model; 65536 context as Lemonade loads it

plan.note: Plans run on roles.plan (Muse-Glimmer-30B, the QA model) in Cline's plan mode (--plan).

dev.note: dev pick (passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-13-dev-cline-311az and QA 2026-10-13-qa-cline-bxk8v): Qwen's Qwen3.8-27B, a dense 27B with vision + tool-calling + MTP, 17.2 GB at UD-Q4_K_XL; Lemonade loads it at 65536. The only dev pick: Muse-Glimmer is the QA model (a Muse dev card would have no QA model of another family) and Qwen3-Coder is the fallback only

qa.note: QA pick (passed kanban models vet for dev and QA 2026-10-12): another family (meta) than the Qwen3.8 dev and Qwen3-Coder fallback (qwen) models, a dense 30B with vision + tool-calling, 16.9 GB at Q4_K_M; Lemonade loads it at 65536 (its max is 131072). A dev card someone puts on Muse-Glimmer itself has no QA model of another family in this preset and waits in Review. gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF-Q4_K_M passed the QA vet (2026-10-13-qa-cline-khuf9) but proved too small for a reliable QA reviewer in the notes project (2026-10-13)

senior.note: fallback dev model (passed kanban models vet for dev 2026-10-13-dev-cline-q9t3z and QA 2026-10-13-qa-cline-0gmwu): Qwen's Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, the dev model's family (qwen) but not the QA model's (meta), so its sibling is still reviewed by Muse-Glimmer; a MoE with 3B active, tool-calling, no vision, 17.4 GB at Q4_K_M, 65536 context as Lemonade loads it (max 262144). The fallback only: as a dev model in the notes project it emitted invalid JSON tool calls on Lemonade (2026-10-13)

tierRules.dev: Lemonade models with the tool-calling label; cost 0
tierRules.qa: a different vendor (model family) than the dev model
tierRules.senior: the fallback dev model: a family other than QA's

tierNotes.dev: Memory budget (one GPU: Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, 96 GB GPU-addressable of 125 GB RAM): dev + QA + fallback must stay resident side by side within 80 GB, leaving 16 GB headroom. Weights (Lemonade's sizes), each loaded at 65536 context: Qwen3.8-27B 17.2 GB, Muse-Glimmer-30B 16.9 GB, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B 17.4 GB: 51.5 GB of weights. Each model's KV cache at 65536 and its compute buffers come on top; their sizes are not measured yet, so check the free memory with all three loaded before raising a context. Change a context with lemonade load <model> --ctx-size <n> --llamacpp vulkan --save-options. Three models resident at once needs Lemonade's max_loaded_models at 3 (and models.providerCapacity.lemonade.maxLoadedModels equal to it). Plans run on the QA model, so they load nothing more. kanban bench calibrate can still compare candidates
tierNotes.qa: requireDifferentVendor reads the family from the model id (Muse → meta, Gemma → google, Qwen → qwen, Laguna → poolside, Devstral → mistral, DeepSeek → deepseek). Muse-Glimmer (meta) reviews the Qwen dev and fallback cards; a dev card on Muse-Glimmer has no QA model of another family here and waits in Review

settings.why: Lemonade/llama.cpp ends Cline turns without the TaskComplete hook; only the turn detector in mode on ends them (report only logs), or every card sits running with an idle TUI
